⚡️ Iran condemns crimes of Israeli regime against Palestinians in Gaza 📌 Tehran, IRNA — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran strongly condemned the crimes committed by the Zionist regime against the oppressed Palestinian people—particularly in Gaza—and emphasized the urgent need for effective action by the international community to halt the genocide and punish the Zionist perpetrators. The Iranian Foreign Ministry in a statement also strongly condemned the crimes of the occupying regime and the terrorist acts committed by Zionist settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank, the most recent instance of which was the arson attack on the Al-Ihsan Mosque. ​ The statement reads: While Gaza has been reduced to a pile of rubble and debris as a result of extensive bombardment—and displaced people, amidst the winter cold, lack even tents to shelter them from the freezing temperatures and rain—Zionist forces, by launching an incursion into central Gaza, are seeking to intensify the killings, genocide, and the slaughter of even more people. ​ The inaction imposed upon international institutions by the United States and the backers of the occupying regime has further emboldened that regime, leading to the continued, egregious violation of human rights in occupied Palestine. ​ Undoubtedly, the United States and other supporters of the occupying regime—most notably Germany, as the second-largest arms supplier to the regime, as well as the United Kingdom, France, and Canada—bear responsibility for the crimes committed in Gaza; they have failed to oppose the atrocities of the occupying regime and have refrained from taking any action—such as intervention or the imposition of proportionate penalties—to address these crimes. ​ Furthermore, all parties that were present and participated in the ceasefire agreement of October 10, 2025, in Sharm El-Sheikh, bear direct responsibility for halting the crimes of the occupying regime. 📲 @Irna_en ​
